correctness.rationale: For Q4 with sixteen bit-vector vertices, Ind2 consists of masks with every selected vertex having at most one selected neighbor. Independently enumerated all 65536 masks; 3055 faces including empty, with fvector (16,120,464,964,960,440,80,10) and reduced Euler -15. Independently reconstructed the sequential vertex-toggle matching: 1514 pairs, critical faces 17 three-cells, six four-cells and four five-cells; exact topological sort checked all 13584 directed incidences and found no cycles. Independently performed all signed integral Morse pair cancellations and recovered the exact two degree-four differentials ±([49158]-[49162]), the four critical five-cell boundaries, the rank-four unimodular minor -1, and d²=0, giving H3=Z^16,H4=Z and no torsion. The Morse CW has a primitive 3/4 cancellation and primitive 4/5 cancellation, with residual π4(wedge S3) components absorbed by changing sphere generators; hence an actual wedge of 16 S3 and one S4, not merely matching homology. Independently lifted the primitive 92-term simplicial four-cycle, verified its entire oriented simplicial boundary vanishes and computed its integral action for all 384 group elements; each agrees with sgn(S4), independently of the checked source script. Independently re-enumerated the orientation-weighted Lefschetz trace for all 384 B4 automorphisms: combining this with H4 sign recovered the asserted V⊕W degree-three character exactly. The claim concerns only Q4,r=2 and rational modules, not an infinite hypercube family.

value.rationale: The four-cube is a canonical highly symmetric sixteen-vertex graph. Its Ind2 complex is nonpure and has a genuinely mixed-dimensional integral wedge; the full 384-element rational B4 character and invariant subspace distinguish it from ordinary independence topology. An exact, fully computed homotopy and equivariant invariant for this natural small periodic grid can serve as a reusable benchmark without claiming an entire family formula.
